name: Wit of the Draining Tomb
body:
School Necromancy; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

Until the end of the combat, once per round, when you successfully hit an enemy that is at or below half its total hit points, you gain 5 temporary hit points. This effect can be triggered once per round.
